# Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**Brand system:** Deep teal (#0E4A47), seafoam (#BFE3DC), warm sand (#F7F1E8), coral accent (#F27B5F). Headings in a rounded humanist serif (like Recoleta); body in Inter. The theme: weeks have rhythm, like tides — calm, not chaotic.

**1. Nav** — Logo (wave mark) left; Product, Pricing, Changelog right; teal "Start free" pill. Frosted white, sticky.

**2. Hero** — Centered single column on sand background. H1: "Your team's week, planned in one flow." Sub: "Tidepool pulls tasks, meetings, and priorities into one shared weekly plan — no status meetings required." Primary CTA "Start your first week"; secondary "See a sample plan." Below: product screenshot in a rounded card with soft teal shadow, subtle animated water gradient behind.

**3. Social proof** — Thin strip of muted team logos: "Trusted by 2,000+ small teams."

**4. The problem** — Two columns. Left: H2 "Mondays shouldn't start with a scavenger hunt," plus copy about scattered Slack threads and surprise deadlines. Right: illustration — cluttered calendar slowly resolving into a calm Tidepool board.

**5. How it works** — Three steps in a row, each with a seafoam icon circle: *Reflect* (Friday wrap-up), *Plan* (15-minute Monday ritual), *Flow* (the week stays visible). Copy stays verbs-first.

**6. Features bento grid** — Four asymmetric tiles alternating sand/seafoam/teal: shared weekly board, workload balancing, focus-time blocks, Slack + calendar integrations. Each tile: short benefit headline, one-line support, small UI crop.

**7. Testimonials** — Three cards, round photos, quotes like "We cancelled our Monday sync in week two."

**8. Pricing** — Two cards: Free ("Driftwood") and Pro ($6/user), Pro highlighted in teal with "Most popular" coral tag.

**9. Final CTA** — Full-width deep teal band with wave-edge top border. H2: "Make Monday the calmest day." Big coral button.

**10. Footer** — Sand background, four link columns, playful microcopy: "High tide at 9:04 — good time to plan."

# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**Brand system:** Deep teal (#0E4A47), seafoam (#BFE3DC), warm sand (#F7F1E8), coral (#F27B5F). Headings in Recoleta, body in Inter. Design rule: every section breathes — generous whitespace reinforces the "calm week" promise.

**1. Nav** — Wave-mark logo left; Product, Pricing, FAQ, "Sign in." Teal pill CTA: "Start free — no card." Sticky, frosted white, shadow appears on scroll.

**2. Hero** — Sand background, left-aligned text column with UI mockup right (rotated 2°, overlapping a soft water gradient — feels alive, not stock). H1: "Plan your whole week in 15 minutes." Sub: "Tidepool turns scattered tasks and meetings into one shared team plan — built Monday morning, visible all week." CTA "Start your first week" + link "Watch 90-sec demo ▸."

**3. Proof strip** — Six grayscale logos + inline stat: "4.8★ · 2,300 teams." Specific numbers beat vague claims.

**4. Problem** — Full-width teal band for contrast. Three floating "chaos cards" (Slack pings, surprise deadline, calendar soup) that visually sink into a calm Tidepool board on scroll. H2: "The week shouldn't manage you." One tight paragraph, no lists.

**5. How it works** — Three steps with numbered seafoam circles: *Reflect* (Friday retro, 5 min), *Plan* (Monday ritual, 15 min), *Flow* (board updates itself as work shifts). Each step ends with a time cost — honesty builds trust.

**6. Feature bento** — Lead tile = the differentiator: **workload balancing** ("See who's drowning before Friday"). Then shared board, focus blocks, integrations. Each tile: bold headline, one supporting line, real UI crop.

**7. Testimonials** — Three quotes with name, role, team size ("Maya Chen, ops lead, team of 7"). Relatable peers over logos.

**8. FAQ** — Four accordion items killing top objections: security, migration, "is this another meeting tool?", pricing limits.

**9. Pricing** — Free "Driftwood" vs. Pro $6/user ($5 annual). Pro in teal with coral "Most popular" tag and guarantee line: "30 days, full refund."

**10. Final CTA + footer** — Teal band, wave edge: "Make Monday the calmest day." Coral button. Sand footer: four link columns, one flourish — live local tide time in microcopy.
